children: BW Businessworld will recognise young sustainability leaders and organisations driving measurable progress across clean energy, decarbonisation, circularity and climate-resilient supply chains

Mumbai, 16 September 2026: BW Businessworld is set to felicitate the winners of the BW Sustainability 40 Under 40 and BW Sustainable World Awards 2026 on 17 September at Novotel, Andheri, Mumbai, as part of the 9th Sustainable World Conclave. The awards will recognise young professionals and organisations contributing to India’s sustainability agenda across areas including decarbonisation, clean energy, circularity and climate-resilient supply chains.

The BW Sustainability 40 Under 40 winners will be felicitated across three dedicated segments during the day. The recognition will honour professionals under the age of 40 who are contributing to sustainability strategy and execution across leading Indian enterprises.

The felicitation will take place alongside panel discussions and case studies featuring sustainability leaders from organisations including Reliance Industries, Axis Bank, Cipla, ICICI Bank, HCLTech, Aditya Birla Group, Godrej Industries Group, JSW Group and Siemens.
The 2026 conclave will be held under the theme “From Ambition to Advantage”, bringing together discussions around how sustainability initiatives can translate into business and organisational value.

The day will conclude with the BW Sustainable World Awards 2026, which will honour organisations and leaders for measurable impact in corporate sustainability. The awards ceremony will follow a keynote by Deepak Thakur, MD & CEO, Hinduja Renewables, focused on scaling sustainable leadership as growth outpaces the broader sustainability ecosystem.

The ceremony will be followed by a celebratory dinner for attendees. The conclave will open with an address titled “Sustainability Beyond Action” by Dr Annurag Batra, Chairman & Editor-in-Chief, BW Businessworld and Founder, Exchange4Media. His address will focus on BW Businessworld’s decade-long effort to recognise sustainability leadership and innovation across India Inc. Across previous editions, the BW Sustainability 40 Under 40 and Sustainable World Awards have recognised young sustainability leaders and organisations for contributions to India’s climate and sustainability goals.
